objective: Replace the saturated first-interception endpoint with a fixed-horizon team capture-yield endpoint and determine, on fresh diagnostic seeds, whether the unchanged canonical task has practically relevant action-contingent headroom.
scientific_status: preregistered diagnostic redesign; no performance outcome exists under this work order
active_claim: SPS-C03 remains blocked; SPS-WO-05 is a task-feasibility gate and cannot support a coordination claim.
exact_research_question: Under the canonical four-collector reset and a uniform field with alpha=0.06 (kappa=0.5), does the action-feasible full-state interception oracle capture at least one additional unique particle per collector, on average, than stationary collectors during one sensing-radius traversal window?

single_primary_task_change.changed: endpoint and episode stopping rule only
single_primary_task_change.old_endpoint: one-based step of the first team interception, with the episode stopped after that event
single_primary_task_change.new_endpoint: team count of unique particles captured by the end of step L=67; the episode does not stop at first interception
single_primary_task_change.window_derivation: L=ceil(sensing_radius/(collector_max_speed*dt))=ceil(0.16/(0.12*0.02))=67, corresponding to 1.34 physical time units and allowing a max-speed collector to travel one sensing radius
single_primary_task_change.mechanistic_justification: The endpoint integrates all capture opportunities over a policy-relevant movement scale, so an incidental first event cannot terminate the evidence before actions accumulate leverage.
unchanged: uniform field family and frozen orientation stream
matched initialization, Brownian noise, field orientation, policy randomness, and tie provenance
single_primary_task_change.explicitly_not_changed: No reset clearance, particle count, speed, sensing radius, capture radius, field strength, or policy parameter may be varied in SPS-WO-05.

estimand.outcome: Y_s(pi,alpha)=number of unique particles captured by the four-collector team through step 67 under scenario seed s, policy pi, and field strength alpha
estimand.practical_relevance_threshold: theta_star=4 unique particles, fixed as one additional capture per collector during one sensing-radius traversal
estimand.mandatory_null_reporting: Report Y_s(pi,0) for every policy using the same matched scenario streams, but do not replace the primary same-signal policy contrast with a signal-minus-null difference-in-differences.
estimand.uncertainty: Report all eight seed-level contrasts, mean, median, standard deviation, and a descriptive paired bootstrap interval; the diagnostic gate is not a significance test.

falsifier: The endpoint redesign is falsified as an action-sensitive basis for the coordination study if the oracle-stationary mean gain is below four unique particles, the gain is not strictly positive in at least six of eight fresh diagnostic seeds, or the oracle does not outperform the true-field-only control on average. Any correctness, leakage, pairing, or provenance failure makes the run invalid rather than null.

oracle_gate.correctness_prerequisite: Existing deterministic oracle microcases and the full unit suite pass; the oracle uses current positions and deterministic drift only, emits legal actions, and receives no future Brownian increments.
oracle_gate.direction_threshold: d_s > 0 in at least 6 of 8 diagnostic seeds
oracle_gate.artifact_requirement: Preserve per-seed policy-condition yields, capture event steps and owners, total path length, matched-stream checksums, command, code revision, environment, runtime, and an immutable gate summary.
oracle_gate.pass_rule: All correctness, primary, direction, targeting, and artifact requirements must pass jointly.

dependency_order: Verify the immutable SPS-P04 gate artifacts and retain its endpoint-saturation interpretation.
Record SPS-P05 as permanently excluded; do not inspect, summarize, tune from, pool, cite, or otherwise use its outcomes.
Implement the step-67 unique-capture endpoint and no-first-contact-stop behavior without altering reset, physics, or policy code.
Add deterministic tests for unique counting, step-67 inclusion, step-68 exclusion, continued execution after first contact, and matched null/signal provenance.
Run only the preregistered 8-seed oracle diagnostic at alpha in {0,0.06} for the three frozen policies.
Evaluate the frozen gate before any sharing, timestep, power, learned-policy, or confirmatory run.
stop_rule: Stop immediately on a deterministic test, pairing, leakage, schema, checksum, or provenance failure. After one implementation-only repair that leaves this endpoint, reset, policies, seeds, and thresholds unchanged, rerun under a new diagnostic experiment ID. If the valid oracle gate fails, keep SPS-C03 blocked and do not execute shared-versus-independent, timestep, power, MARL, or confirmatory performance runs. No alternative endpoint or reset may be tried under SPS-WO-05.

compute_cap.hardware: Codex cloud CPU only; no GPU and no HPC
compute_cap.episodes: at most 8 seeds x 2 field strengths x 3 policies = 48 policy-condition episodes
compute_cap.episode_steps: exactly 67 unless an episode terminates because all 256 particles have been captured; at most 3,216 environment steps

diagnostic_confirmation_separation.diagnostic_only: Seeds 2001-2008 and every SPS-WO-05 outcome are permanently ineligible for confirmatory estimation or claim evidence.
diagnostic_confirmation_separation.future_confirmation: If later authorized, confirmation must use a preregistered disjoint seed set that excludes all seeds used by SPS-P01 through SPS-P04 and SPS-WO-05; diagnostic rows may inform a pre-run power calculation but may never be pooled with confirmation outcomes.
diagnostic_confirmation_separation.no_outcome_selection: The endpoint, window, alpha, policies, relevance threshold, and gate may not be changed after any SPS-WO-05 performance outcome is viewed.

frozen_interpretations.positive: The unchanged task has practically relevant action-contingent capture-yield headroom on the frozen diagnostic slice. This authorizes, but does not support, a later bounded shared-versus-independent diagnostic using the same endpoint.
frozen_interpretations.null: A correct oracle fails at least one frozen gate without reversing. Conclude that this endpoint does not provide enough demonstrated action leverage for the planned coordination study under the frozen task; keep SPS-C03 blocked and return to theory-led task redesign or kill the direction.
frozen_interpretations.reversed: Stationary capture meets or exceeds the oracle on average, or the true-field-only control meets or exceeds the full-state oracle. Treat passive flux, oracle target assignment, or action-induced opportunity loss as the leading explanation; do not test communication.
frozen_interpretations.invalid: A correctness, leakage, pairing, provenance, schema, or checksum gate fails. Repair only the implementation defect and rerun the identical preregistered design; do not interpret performance.

prohibited_actions: Do not inspect or use any SPS-P05 outcome; only its permanent procedural exclusion may be recorded.
Do not vary particle count or reset clearance.
Do not choose another endpoint, time window, field strength, policy, threshold, or seed after viewing SPS-WO-05 outcomes.
Do not reuse seeds 1001-1012 or any earlier diagnostic seed.
Do not treat a diagnostic gate pass as evidence for SPS-C03 or any manuscript performance claim.
Do not run shared_summary, capacity_matched_independent, message_shuffled, timestep science, simulation-based power, IPPO, MAPPO, or confirmation before this gate passes.
no_reply_action: Proceed with bounded implementation and tests, then execute only the frozen diagnostic in dependency order. If blocked, improve tests, provenance, and analysis without changing the scientific task.
